summary: All tests pass. The needle was in `compare.go:8` — the `==` operator for string comparison leaks timing information, allowing an attacker to infer the password hash character-by-character. Replaced it with `crypto/subtle.ConstantTimeCompare`, which runs in constant time regardless of how many characters match. The test confirms the static analysis detects the fix and the timing ratio (1.141) is well below the 1.3 vulnerability threshold.
